evals.prompt: PagerDuty fired: 500 error rate 80% on payment API for 5 minutes. Correlated with deploy at 14:03. What do we do?
evals.expected_output: Runs full incident procedure: Detect/Acknowledge, Assess (severity S1/S2, blast radius), Mitigate (rollback first, then kill-switch, etc.), Communicate (initial status + 5-min updates), Fix Forward (hand off to /hotfix if needed), Resolve/Monitor, Post-Mortem scheduling.

assertions.name: mitigation_ordered
assertions.description: Response lists mitigation options in speed order: rollback → kill-switch → circuit breaker → scale → hotfix

assertions.name: rollback_first
assertions.description: Response checks rollback as the first mitigation option

assertions.name: communication_plan
assertions.description: Response includes communication plan with timing (initial within 5 min, updates every 5 min)

assertions.name: evidence_preservation
assertions.description: Response mentions preserving evidence before fixing

assertions.name: post_mortem_scheduled
assertions.description: Response schedules or reminds about /post-mortem for S1/S2

evals.prompt: We detected unauthorized data access in our production database. Potential exfiltration. This is a security incident.
evals.expected_output: Security breach = redirect to security-reviewer FIRST. Do NOT classify severity or run normal incident procedure. Once security-reviewer clears forensic steps, return to incident for infrastructure recovery.

assertions.name: redirect_to_security_reviewer
assertions.description: Response redirects to security-reviewer immediately, before any incident severity classification

assertions.name: no_s1_classification
assertions.description: Response does NOT classify this as S1 through the normal incident severity table

assertions.name: no_mitigation_procedure
assertions.description: Response does NOT run the 7-step incident mitigation procedure before security clearance

assertions.name: forensic_first
assertions.description: Response mentions forensic steps / security investigation as the first priority

evals.prompt: My local dev server keeps crashing when I run the tests. Can you run incident response on this?
evals.expected_output: Non-production issue. Should decline and redirect to /fix-bug or /diagnose.

assertions.name: non_production_reason
assertions.description: Response states this is not a production incident

assertions.name: no_severity_table
assertions.description: Response does NOT apply S1-S4 severity classification
